mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz.wcs_task_h ( wcs_task_id, task_type, task_status, eqp_pallet_id, cycle_no, pallet_id, order_task_id, station_id, sku_code, lot_id, qty, task_message_id, dispatched_at, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{wcsTaskId}, #{taskType}, 'DISPATCHING', #{eqpPalletId}, #{cycleNo}, #{palletId}, #{orderTaskId}, #{stationId}, #{skuCode}, #{lotId}, #{qty}, #{taskMessageId}, #{dispatchedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdBy}, 'SYSTEM'), COALESCE(#{updatedBy}, 'SYSTEM') )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'DISPATCHED', shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), ack_message_id = #{ackMessageId}, ack_result = #{ackResult}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'REJECTED', shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), ack_message_id = #{ackMessageId}, ack_result = 'REJECTED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'STARTED', started_at = #{startedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'COMPLETED', completed_at = #{completedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}

UPDATE biz.wcs_task_h SET task_status = 'FAILED', fail_reason = #{failReason}, completed_at = #{failedAt}, shuttle_id = COALESCE(#{shuttleId}, shuttle_id), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE wcs_task_id = #{wcsTaskId} AND task_type = #{taskType}
